questions.question: What is a computer network?
questions.explanation: A computer network is a collection of interconnected devices that communicate and share resources.

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing packets between different networks?
questions.explanation: The Network layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing and routing of packets across networks.

questions.question: Which protocol translates domain names into IP addresses?
questions.explanation: The Domain Name System (DNS) maps human-readable domain names to IP addresses.

questions.question: How many bits are there in an IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: An IPv4 address is 32 bits long, usually written as four decimal octets. IPv6 addresses are 128 bits.

questions.question: Which device forwards Ethernet frames using MAC addresses and operates mainly at the Data Link layer?
questions.explanation: A switch learns MAC addresses and forwards frames only to the port where the destination lives. A hub simply repeats signals to every port.

questions.question: Which transport-layer protocol provides reliable, connection-oriented delivery?
questions.explanation: TCP establishes a connection, acknowledges data and retransmits lost segments. UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery.

questions.question: What is the default port number used by HTTPS?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default. Port 80 is used for plain HTTP and port 21 for FTP control.

questions.question: In which network topology is every device connected to a central hub or switch?
questions.explanation: In a star topology each node has its own link to a central device, so one failed cable affects only one node.

questions.question: Which protocol automatically assigns IP addresses to hosts on a network?
questions.explanation: The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) leases IP addresses and related settings such as gateway and DNS servers.

questions.question: The subnet mask 255.255.255.0 corresponds to which CIDR prefix length?
questions.explanation: 255.255.255.0 has 24 leading one-bits (three full octets), so the prefix length is /24.
